name: orthomcl-all-plasmodium-asks-which-all
turns: Which ortholog groups are present in all Plasmodium species but absent from Toxoplasma gondii?
rationale: Presence in every member of a clade with many strains and incomplete assemblies has three readings: every genome, a share of the genomes, or every species. The turn asks once, with the genome and strain counts, before it binds; the absence half needs no question.

provenance.curatorNote: The second suggested OrthoMCL prompt. The question is left unanswered so the case pins that it is asked.
